Columns: graph, departure, size, perturbation (delete/flip), n_replicates (used), replicates_run (20 MT-Bench, 5 Arena), delta_mean, pooled_lo/hi (replicate-mean interval), share_rep_beyond, detected, se_ratio_cluster_med, se_ratio_cmp_med, design_effect_cluster. All rows synthetic. Note: on MT-Bench 1-6 of the 20 replicates per cell drop out because they have <5 pairs at z in [1,8]; n_replicates is the number used. Reason for the sizes (REPRODUCE.md): fixed in PREANALYSIS rev 3 on the logit scale from small to large enough to find where the test breaks (overdispersion sd 2 -> design effect ~6; position bias 2 shifts a win probability by up to 0.4); not calibrated to departures measured in real data, so 'not detected' refers to these sizes only. Do not quote Arena rows as a table until the cells are complete; I will comment when they are.
